mean_en: the quality of always behaving in the same way or of having the same opinions, standard, etc.; the quality of being consistent
sentence: We need to ensure consistency in the quality of our products across all factories.
sentence_trans: 我们需要确保所有工厂生产的产品质量一致。
word_etyma: con共同 + sist站立 + ency名词后缀 → consistency一致性，连贯性
